record.body:
## Problem

`score:backlog-item` (41 records, 21 live) and `score:feedback` (0 records) carry idea-shaped intent inside work planning. The dashboard backlog panel, `orchestra/views.py` and the `engage` skill read them.

## Approach

Not yet scoped. Decide at plan-phase: how records move across namespaces, and how the dashboard, views and `engage` switch to `composer:idea` before both score types are removed.

## Exit criteria

Decide at plan-phase. The gate: every acceptance passes, `canon validate` reports no errors on the live store after the conversion, and no tracked file outside `docs/history/` names `score:backlog-item` or `score:feedback`.

payload.title: Convert backlog and feedback to ideas
